response.rationale: Both labels describe the same thing: membership that comes with a free-entry allowance. A adds "registration", which reads as part of handling membership rather than a separate capability. The graph backs this up. A's community:1 contains both MemberRepository (node 1cdbf101edd01700, persistence) and RinkService (node 21c65604dec116b1, domain/business). B's component:business also contains RinkService. MemberRepository has fan-in 4 and RinkService has fan-out 25, which fits RinkService being the domain service that uses member persistence. So the two labels look like one capability seen from different groupings: A by community, B by component. Confidence is not higher because the visible code is only the two class declarations, and the graph doesn't show an edge linking RinkService to MemberRepository directly.
